pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to losing positions; pyramiding only authorized in the direction of the primary trend after a minimum +$10.00 floating profit cushion is locked via trailing stop.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution within a 15-minute window before or after high-impact USD/XAU macroeconomic data releases, combined with a mandatory multi-timeframe ATR volatility filter.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing and partial profit-taking once floating profits hit +$15.00 to prevent evaporation, allowing the remaining runner to target +$30.00+.
